question: Should a channel that exhausts the manager's crash-loop budget remain stopped until explicit operator action, or should the health monitor revive it under a separate bounded policy?
rationale: Current main explicitly tests post-give-up revival, while this PR makes give-up terminal; source evidence cannot determine which availability policy maintainers now intend.

options.title: Preserve bounded revival
options.body: Fix active-backoff counter ownership while retaining an explicit, separately budgeted post-give-up health-monitor recovery path.

options.title: Make give-up terminal
options.body: Require explicit operator or configuration action after manager retries are exhausted, accepting the change from current recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded revival
recommendation.body: Fix active-backoff counter ownership while retaining an explicit, separately budgeted post-give-up health-monitor recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest continuing ownership of gateway health-monitor recovery semantics.
